pages.raw_meta: Vail Resorts, Inc. is the premier mountain resort company in the world and a leader in luxury, destination-based travel at iconic locations.
raw_blocks: 42 MOUNTAIN RESORTS, CONNECTED ​
We own and operate the most renowned destination resorts in the world as well as regional and local ski areas outside major cities, and connect them all through one unrivaled network.​
Our growing portfolio of owned and operated resorts.
TIME Magazine: America’s Best Companies 🏆

In 2026, Vail Resorts was recognized on TIME Magazine’s annual list of America’s Best Companies for the third consecutive year, reflecting its continued progress in sustainability, investment in employee experience, and focus on growth and innovation.
Forbes: America’s Best Employers for Company Culture 🏆
Forbes and Statista recognized Vail Resorts as one of America’s Best Employers for Company Culture in 2026.
Mental Health America: Bell Seal for Workplace Mental Health 🏆
Vail Resorts was recognized by Mental Health America as a 2026 recipient of the Bell Seal for Workplace Mental Health for the company’s ongoing commitment to creating mentally healthy workplaces.​
Newsweek: America’s Most Charitable Companies 🏆
Newsweek and Statista recognized Vail Resorts as one of America’s Most Charitable Companies in 2026 for its corporate philanthropy and community impact.
National Ski Areas Association: Innovation in Sustainability 🏆

Vail Resorts’ Community Conversation: Climate series is an innovative approach to sustainability, grounded in hope, resilience, and community well-being. In recognition of this initiative, the National Ski Areas Association awarded Vail Resorts a 2025 Innovation in Sustainability Award.
Fast Company: Most Innovative Company 🏆
Vail Resorts was named one of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies of 2024 for My Epic Gear, its first-of-its-kind ski gear membership program.
Newsweek: Most Trustworthy Companies in America 🏆
For the fourth consecutive year, Vail Resorts was recognized by Newsweek as one of the 2026 Most Trustworthy Companies in America.
Newsweek: America’s Most Admired Workplaces 🏆
Vail Resorts was recognized by Newsweek as one of America’s Most Admired Workplaces of 2025.
National Ski Areas Association: Climate Change Impact Award 🏆
Vail Resorts received the 2023 Golden Eagle Climate Change Impact Award for achieving 100% renewable electricity in North America and 96% renewable electricity enterprise-wide.
Newsweek: America’s Greatest Companies 🏆
Vail Resorts was recognized as one of America’s Greatest Companies 2025, a list highlighting 650 U.S. companies operating at the highest levels of business performance.
ENDLESS EXPERIENCES ON ONE PASS ​
Whether our guests want to ski and ride one day or every day, close to home or at world-class destinations, our Epic Passes provide unmatched value, flexibility, and access.
Our mission is to create the Experience of a Lifetime for our employees, so they can, in turn, create the Experience of a Lifetime for our guests.​
Our team members do not work for Vail Resorts, they are Vail Resorts. We know an investment in them is a direct investment in the guest experience. ​

To improve the guest experience, we have invested over $2.2 billion in the past 15 years. New lifts, new terrain and state-of-the-art facilities help our guests make the most of their day on mountain. ​
We believe that digital innovation, more than ever, will be key for delivering a great guest experience on-mountain. Read about the latest innovations we’re pioneering for the industry. ​
Delivering an experience is what we do; our EpicPromise is to do it responsibly . ​

We take climate change seriously and are on track to reach a zero net operating footprint by 2030 across all 42 of our mountain resorts. Commitment to Zero means: zero net emissions, zero waste to landfill, and zero net operating impact on forests and habitat. ​
​We are dedicated to helping our mountain resort communities thrive through direct engagement and grants, and by providing support on shared priorities: affordable housing, mental health, and more.

We are committed to removing barriers to entry and creating a more inclusive sport through our programs for youth, people living with disability, and populations that have historically been underrepresented in the snow sports industry.
We support our employees with natural disaster and hardship relief grants and scholarships, and provide programs that support our employees through mind, body, and wallet.
Epic Experience: Vail Resorts Puts Guest Experience at the Center of New Growth Plan
Company begins multi-year transformation of the end-to-end guest journey, setting a new standard for the modern ski experience across its network of premier mountain destinations.
Katz Amsterdam Foundation Marks a Decade of Investments in Mountain Communities at Annual Convening; Expands Shared Mental Health Data Dashboard

Vail Resorts, Inc. today announced that Rob Katz, current Executive Chairperson and former Chief Executive Officer, has been appointed CEO of the Company.

Introducing My Epic Pro for Ski and Ride School, a new technology that creates a seamless, connected and next-level experience. In the 2025/26 season, My Epic Pro will be automatically available in the My Epic app at Vail Mountain, Beaver Creek, Breckenridge and Keystone.

Today, Vail Resorts, Inc. pledges $1 million to The Nature Conservancy (TNC), a global environmental nonprofit working to create a world where people and nature can thrive.

Vail Resorts is honored to receive five awards from the National Ski Areas Association (NSAA), the trade association for ski area owners and operators.

Vail Resorts, Inc. closed on its purchase of Crans-Montana Mountain Resort, a renowned destination ski resort with a steep history as an outdoor sports haven in Switzerland and around the world.

pages.raw_meta: Vail Resorts is committed to providing the Experience of a Lifetime across destination resorts and dozens of regional and local ski areas.
raw_blocks: Through our passionate team, on-mountain investments, and technological innovations, we deliver experiences that help people discover the magic of the mountains.
Our team members do not work for Vail Resorts, they are Vail Resorts. We know an investment in them is a direct investment in the guest experience. ​

To improve the guest experience, we have invested over $2.2 billion in the past 15 years. New lifts, new terrain, and state-of-the-art facilities help our guests make the most of their day on mountain.
We believe that digital innovation, more than ever, will be key for delivering a great guest experience on-mountain. Read about the latest innovations we’re pioneering for the industry. ​
Learn More About How Our Guest Experience Comes To Life

Vail Resorts Retail is the premier outdoor specialty retail company in the industry and the largest snow sports retailer with over 250 owned and operated locations throughout the U.S. and Canada, including branded stores such as Burton, Columbia and Patagonia, specialty rental shops, luxury retail stores as well as online ski rentals and direct-to-lodging delivery services at all Vail Resorts properties. Coming soon: My Epic Gear, a membership program that reimagines gear ownership, with more choice and lower cost.

Our mountain resorts are home to the world’s finest ski and snowboard schools, led by thousands of the industry’s top professional instructors from around the globe. We are proud to cultivate positive learning experiences and a genuine passion for snowsports. In recent years, lesson offerings have expanded to include adaptive programs, advance terrain park education, and highly certified experts to guide even the most advanced skiers and riders.

Vail Resorts Hospitality owns and operates luxury hotels under the RockResorts brand, a wholly owned subsidiary of Vail Resorts that sets the standard for belonging in some of the world’s most admired destinations. The company also manages hotels and condominiums in mountain resort communities, several award-winning golf courses and three destination resorts in the Grand Teton National Park.

With over 300 food and beverage outlets across our family of mountain resorts, guests can find a broad range of dining options including coffee shops, grab-and-go and quick service outlets, as well as full service and fine dining restaurants. Our food and beverage offerings are located in resort base areas, mid-mountain, and high-alpine lodges as well as within our hospitality footprint. Our team also offers incredible dining experiences, such as sleigh rides and snow cats that carry guests to award-winning restaurants in historic cabins and homesteads.

Epic Mountain Express provides the easiest way from Denver International Airport to popular Colorado mountain resort areas, including Vail, Breckenridge, Keystone, Frisco, Beaver Creek, Bachelor Gulch, and surrounding ski resort areas. Part of our Lodging division, Epic Mountain Express offers airport transfers for all budgets and all travelers.

Introducing My Epic Gear: a first of its kind gear membership program. Get access to the latest skis, snowboards and boots with personalized insoles, all delivered to you or ready slopeside. It’s better than renting, easier than owning, and just for you in the palm of your hand in the My Epic App. Get the most out of your membership when you reserve in advance. Available at 12 North American resorts.
From One Day To Every Day​

Our Pass Holders get the best deal in skiing and riding with incredible value, flexibility, and access. By committing to their pass before the season begins, it creates stability for our company—allowing us to continuously invest back into our resorts, communities, employees, and the environment.

World-class mountain landscapes and trails, including those found at the legendary Whistler Blackcomb Bike Park, allow us to deliver an Experience of a Lifetime year-round. Our list of summer activities and experiences at our mountain resorts spans lift-served mountain biking and hiking, mountain coasters, zip lines, kids’ activities and Epic Discovery zones, plus much more. Vail Resorts also operates a number of high-altitude golf courses with exceptional views, including Red Sky Golf Club, Beaver Creek Golf Club, and Canyons Golf , as well as fly fishing operations, including Taylor Creek Fly Shops and Gore Creek Fly Fisherman. ​

Vail Resorts owns the Grand Teton Lodge Company, which is based in the Jackson Hole area in Wyoming and operates within Grand Teton National Park under a concession agreement with the National Park Service. Grand Teton Lodge Company operates hotels, dining, campgrounds and activities, with three lodging options: Jackson Lake Lodge, a full service, 385-room resort; Jenny Lake Lodge, a small, rustically elegant retreat with 37 cabins; and Colter Bay Village, a facility with 166 log cabins, 66 tent cabins, 337 campsites and a 112-space recreational vehicle park.

We also own the Jackson Hole Golf & Tennis Club and Flagg Ranch, centrally located between Yellowstone National Park and Grand Teton National Park. Grand Teton Lodge Company’s operating season generally runs from mid-May through the end of September.

pages.raw_meta: Repsonsibility for the natural environment, community & employee support and accessibility and inclusivity in sport are at the forefront of EpicPromise.
raw_blocks: Our Mountains. our communities. our future.
Igniting a passion for the outdoors, conserving the natural environment, supporting our local communities and employees, and making our sport more accessible and inclusive: that is our EpicPromise.
PRODUCTS, SERVICES & CASH GRANTS DONATED
AWARDED TO TEAM MEMBERS & THEIR FAMILIES

The environment is our business, and we have a special responsibility to protect it. We have made a promise to reach a zero net operating footprint by 2030, and are on track to achieve this bold goal. For AB 1305 substantiation of emissions claims, click here .
Commitment to Zero by 2030

We are committed to the people who live, work, and play in our mountain communities through direct engagement and grants, and providing support on shared priorities, including affordable housing, mental health and more. ​

Be Inclusive is one of our core values in how we operate as company and steward the sport. We are focused on driving inclusion in three ways: fostering a welcoming culture, diversifying our talent, and expanding access to our sport.
We cannot achieve our mission without our team. The EpicPromise Employee Foundation supports team members and their dependents in the pursuit of their dreams and lends a hand in times of need.​

Mountain communities are disproportionately impacted by mental health crises. For many, there is a lack of access to services and increased stigma surrounding the topic. We recognize mental health as a critical part of our overall health and wellness and are doing our part to ensure our teams and broader communities have access to the tools and resources they need for support.
